description.narrative: strategic collaboration between the Syrian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates (MoFAE) and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) to strengthen Syria’s diplomatic capacity during a critical transitional period. The initiative focuses on enhancing the skills and competencies of Syrian diplomats through specialized training programmes, including international exposure and modern diplomatic practices. It also emphasizes institutional support by rehabilitating and equipping the Syrian Diplomatic Institute with updated infrastructure, furniture, and IT systems. Additionally, the partnership introduces innovative training approaches, such as the Learning Experience Facilitators (LXF) methodology, to ensure sustainable and effective knowledge transfer. Overall, the cooperation aims to facilitate Syria’s reintegration into the international community, rebuild trust with global partners, and contribute to long-term peacebuilding and development efforts
